title: Which identity verification platforms are used by crypto asset service providers?
summary: Platforms with named crypto-asset service provider customers: default methods, customers' MiCA status and what a CASP should ask before choosing.
body_markdown:
*Identity verification platforms with named crypto-asset service provider (CASP) customers, what each one does and what to ask before choosing.*


Identity verification platforms used by crypto-asset service providers (CASPs) include Authologic, Didit, Entrust (formerly Onfido), Fourthline, IDnow and Veriff. Each of them publicly names at least one crypto platform among its customers. They differ in the default method: Authologic leads with eIDs, bank IDs and digital wallets, while the others lead with document and selfie checks, and IDnow also offers video identification and the German identity card as an eID.
